articles.summary: AST SpaceMobile launched its next-generation satellites, BlueBird 11, 12, and 13, to low Earth orbit on August 5 at 3:42 AM EDT. The satellite lifted off from Cape Canaveral, Florida aboard the Falcon 9 rocket. Watch AST SpaceMobile’s live show featuring launch status updates, new videos, interviews with special guests, and more.
articles.title: Live Webcast: AST SpaceMobile BlueBird 11, 12, and 13 Mission Launch
